pairs.evidence: src/app/demo/page.tsx:33 The /demo entry forwards the whole query string instead of an allow-list such as tour, so /demo?seed=7 reaches demoSeedFromUrl (src/lib/demoRealtime.ts:43) and changes which scripted review and persona arrive, making the seed viewer-settable when the technique requires a checked-in constant no viewer can set.

techniques.evidence: src/app/demo/page.tsx:33 Forwards any query, including ?seed= (pinned by src/lib/demoEntry.test.ts:10), into the dashboard where useSyncedRealtime passes demoSeedFromUrl(window.location.search) to mulberry32. The generator itself is seeded and defaults to 1; the defect is that the viewer can pick the world.

src/app/demo/page.tsx:48 The entry is a route in the shipped artifact that records the choice in session state and redirects, with a bounded wait that swaps the spinner for a manual link, as the technique's entry-failure rule asks.

src/app/demo/page.tsx:35 Scope is the clauses this context owns: entry happens only on an explicit visit to /demo, with no inference from empty or failed data. /demo and /preview are disallowed in src/app/robots.ts:13. Marker, lying controls and count rule live in dashboard chrome and were not judged here.
